lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the highest-intensity local maxima are concentrated in the central-lateral region posterior to the fourth and fifth gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a faint rectilinear grid structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, vertically-oriented curved linear indentation is visible on the upper flank, immediately posterior to the terminal gill slit.
